description: This Python source file implements the PillarSecurity Guardrail class for the LiteLLM framework, including utility functions, exception classes, and methods for scanning and potentially blocking or monitoring LLM requests and responses based on security analysis via the Pillar API.

classes.name: PillarGuardrail
classes.description: A security guardrail class that interacts with the Pillar Security API to scan prompts and responses, blocking or monitoring content based on security rules.
